_about: Pinned sources of truth for the UCP conformance tester. NEVER test against main/feature branches; pin by the SHAs below. Regenerate intentionally and review the diff. See docs/spec-coverage.md for methodology.

official_conformance_suite.note: SIGNAL, NOT ORACLE. RE-PINNED 2026-08-03 from f252c0d7 (2026-07-31): one upstream commit, conformance#72 (fulfillment_test.py asserts the configured base price instead of a hardcoded one) — a test-soundness fix, no new assertions. Prior re-pin history: RE-PINNED 2026-07-31 from 948e7d22 (2026-06-23, ~38d stale per the sources-age tripwire). The old note said this suite hard-asserts spec version 2026-01-23 — that is NO LONGER TRUE at this SHA: protocol_test now validates the discovery version structurally (date-shaped) and takes the exact-version assertion from conformance_input.json ('ucp_version', default in integration_test_utils), so the suite tests whichever release the merchant targets. schema_validator.note: Rust CLI (`cargo install ucp-schema`). Used as the schema-validation ORACLE. No release tags; pinned to main SHA. Does NOT cover prose-only invariants (totals sums, lookup dedup, line-item retention) — those are separate coded checks. RE-PINNED 2026-07-29 from 115ae836 (2026-06-30): picks up ucp-schema #37 (namespace authority binding now enforced on services and payment_handlers, not just capabilities — ucp#530) and #41 (accept exact authority match, e.g. a handler com.example.pay served from pay.example.com). Both engine changes verified NON-REGRESSING against our conformant fixtures: the full selftest stayed 52/52 green under the new binary, and the new engine's own 68 unit/integration/doc tests pass (incl. verify_bindings_rejects_unbound_service/_payment_handler + accepts_exact_authority_match). Strictly more faithful; #41 is only more permissive, so it cannot introduce a false-reject.

reference_sample_server.note: Flower Shop reference merchant (samples/rest/python/server) — the KNOWN-COMPLIANT target for self-validation. RE-PINNED 2026-08-03 from 2e5b77c1 (2026-07-31). Three commits: our merged samples#156 (currency determined server side — the checkout.idempotency_conflict known-defect entry expires with this pin), our merged samples#122 (RFC 9421 request signature verification — config require_signatures DEFAULTS FALSE, so unsigned probes still pass; signatures are verified only when a Signature header is present), and upstream #157 (nodejs discount allocation JSONPath, no effect on the python golden). Prior 07-31 re-pin context still applies: serves spec 2026-04-08; includes samples#152 (valid seeded totals) and #153 (discovery Cache-Control). A no-op test still passes against this server, which is why every check also needs a negative fixture (mutation proxy). Run on port 8182; sim endpoints gated by --simulation_secret.
reference_sample_server.sdk_resolution: This SHA DROPPED the server pyproject's [tool.uv.sources] ucp-sdk = { path = '../../../../python-sdk/', editable = true }. The server therefore resolves ucp-sdk from PyPI, NOT from our SHA-pinned vendored python-sdk. Left unmanaged that turns a pinned golden into a floating one, defeating the purpose of this lock, so the resolved PyPI version is recorded in reference_sdk.pypi_pin and asserted at boot.

reference_sdk.pypi_pin_note: BUMPED 2026-08-03 from 0.4.3: PyPI 0.4.4 (uploaded 09:16Z, release v2026-04-08-4) is the release cut for our merged python-sdk#57 (contains/minContains/maxContains validators enforced on generated models). The golden survives these stricter validators because samples#152 (valid seeded totals) was built for exactly that combination — the #57/#152 coordination proved 69/0 with validators active. serve_golden.sh asserts this exact version at boot.
reference_sdk.note: HOW THE GOLDEN GETS ITS SDK CHANGED AT THE 2026-07-31 RE-PIN. Before: the 2026-01-23 Flower Shop server took ucp-sdk as an editable path dep, so this vendored SHA (f54858e, the last 2026-01-23-compatible SDK, 0.3.0 — the commit immediately before python-sdk main's 'upgrade SDK to UCP v2026-04-08', which ImportErrors on Checkout from ap2_mandate) WAS the SDK under test. After: the re-pinned server has no [tool.uv.sources], so it installs ucp-sdk from PyPI and this vendored clone is no longer what the golden runs. The clone is still materialized (cheap, and it keeps the 01-23 trio reproducible), but the version that actually matters for a reproducible verdict is pypi_pin above — the resolved PyPI release the golden runs on. serve_golden.sh asserts the installed version equals pypi_pin and fails loudly on drift, so a silent PyPI bump can never change a verdict unnoticed. Bump pypi_pin deliberately, the same way a SHA is re-pinned. The underlying rule is unchanged: pin compatible trios (conformance/samples/SDK), not bare main.
